title: CSV parser
goal: Implement parseCsv(text) and toCsv(rows) in src/csv.js to correctly parse and serialize CSV text.

steps.title: Parse and serialize CSV
steps.detail:
src/csv.js exports parseCsv(text) and toCsv(rows). parseCsv returns an array of rows, each an array of strings. Rules: fields are separated by commas; rows end at a line feed or a carriage return plus line feed; a final line ending does not create an extra row; the empty text gives []; a blank line in the middle of the text gives a row with one empty string, ['']; a field may be wrapped in double quotes, and inside quotes commas, line feeds and carriage returns are ordinary characters and a doubled double quote is one double quote; a quoted empty field is an empty string; spaces are kept exactly as written (no trimming); a quote that is never closed throws a SyntaxError whose message starts with 'Unterminated quote'; any character between a closing quote and the next comma or line ending throws a SyntaxError whose message starts with 'Unexpected character'; a double quote in the middle of an unquoted field is an ordinary character. toCsv turns rows back into text: a field that contains a comma, a double quote, a line feed or a carriage return is wrapped in double quotes with inner double quotes doubled; other fields are written as they are; fields are joined by commas, rows by a line feed, and there is no line ending after the last row; toCsv([]) is the empty string. Examples: parseCsv('a,b
1,2
') is [['a','b'],['1','2']]; parseCsv('a,"b,c"
') is [['a','b,c']]; parseCsv('"say ""hi"""') is [['say "hi"']]; parseCsv('x,"line1
line2",y') is [['x','line1
line2','y']]; parseCsv('a,,c') is [['a','','c']]; parseCsv('a

b') is [['a'],[''],['b']]; parseCsv('') is []; parseCsv(' a , b ') is [[' a ',' b ']]; parseCsv('5" nail,x') is [['5" nail','x']]; parseCsv('"abc') throws SyntaxError starting 'Unterminated quote'; parseCsv('"a"b,c') throws SyntaxError starting 'Unexpected character'; toCsv([['a','b,c'],['say "hi"','x']]) is 'a,"b,c"
"say ""hi""",x'; parseCsv(toCsv(rows)) equals rows for rows [['a','b
c'],['',',']]. Export with module.exports = { parseCsv, toCsv } (CommonJS). Add tests in test/csv.test.js (node:test) that cover these rules and examples.
